setup.title: HPC4 access & setup
setup.use: Check how to request access, connect, and find the cluster documentation.

workshops.title: ASC01: ASC27 First-Principles Curriculum
workshops.use: Revisit the curriculum introduction, remote development workflow, and the discussion of MPI and GPU performance.

workshops.title: Week 01: Linux basics & Git
workshops.use: Revisit shell navigation, output redirection, tmux, and the branch-to-PR workflow before starting the quests.

collections.title: ARCHER2 training
collections.use: Browse public training on Slurm scheduling, OpenMP GPU offload, and MPI. The examples use ARCHER2, not HPC4.

courses.title: GPU programming using OpenMP
courses.use: Learn to move computation and data to a GPU with OpenMP directives and check whether offloading helps.

courses.title: Slurm job scheduling
courses.use: See what happens after you submit a batch job. The examples use ARCHER2, not HPC4.

courses.title: Message-passing programming with MPI
courses.use: Practice sending messages between processes before writing your first multi-node parallel program.

references.title: Linux knowledge base
references.use: Look up Linux commands, shell concepts, and working with files.

references.title: Linux shell crash course
references.use: Try short shell exercises before the Linux & Git workshop, or use the companion video to review.

references.title: Git and GitHub knowledge base
references.use: Check how to work with Git and open a pull request.

references.title: Slurm sbatch manual
references.use: Look up a batch script option, time limit, or output setting.

references.title: Environment modules guide
references.use: Learn to discover and load software with Lmod. Package names and examples are specific to Utah, not HPC4.

references.title: 2026 HPC tutorials
references.use: Watch tool maintainers install software with Spack and profile applications with Caliper and Thicket.

references.title: CS149: Parallel Computing
references.use: Study how locality, communication, and GPU execution affect parallel performance.

references.title: ASC27 curriculum
references.use: Check the workshop roadmap or find a slide deck when planning a session.
